messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Re: memory allocation issue
parts:
We usually use human data and lately I tested the package with R 3.0.1. I think, if you can read the file with read.table() but not with methylKit, then I can look into it. When reading in the data methylKit depends on read.table() and configures the data frame afterwards.

Please also share your sessionInfo(). It is hard figure out if this is an R specific issue or methylKit specific issue.

But this sounds like a configuration issue because you are on a supercomputer and can't read in 1.5 GB file. Also checked lonestar and stampede clusters you have there, they don't have the latest R versions. It may be a specific problem with your data set and machine configuration. Let me know how it goes. 

Best,
Altuna
